actions.name: Exploit Log4Shell vulnerability in VMware Horizon server
actions.description: The threat actors exploited Log4Shell for initial access to the organization’s unpatched VMware Horizon server.

actions.name: Run PowerShell commands to add exclusion rule to Windows Defender
actions.description: The actors ran PowerShell commands that added an exclusion rule to Windows Defender allowing bypass of virus scans.

actions.name: Download and execute XMRig crypto mining software
actions.description: The exploit payload downloaded mdeploy.text from 182.54.217[.]2/mdepoy.txt to C:\users\public\mde.ps1, which then downloaded file.zip containing XMRig miner and associated files.

actions.name: Create Scheduled Task to execute RuntimeBroker.exe daily as SYSTEM
actions.description: The exploit payload created a Scheduled Task named RuntimeBrokerService.exe that executed RuntimeBroker.exe daily as SYSTEM to maintain persistence.

actions.name: Use RDP and DefaultAccount to move laterally to VMware VDI-KMS host
actions.description: After initial access, the actors used RDP and the built-in Windows user account DefaultAccount to move laterally to a VMware VDI-KMS host.

actions.name: Download PsExec, Mimikatz, and Ngrok tools to VDI-KMS host
actions.description: The actors downloaded around 30 megabytes of files including PsExec, Mimikatz, and Ngrok from a transfer.sh server to the VDI-KMS host.

actions.name: Execute Mimikatz on VDI-KMS to harvest credentials
actions.description: The threat actors executed Mimikatz on VDI-KMS to harvest credentials.

actions.name: Create rogue domain administrator account using Mimikatz
actions.description: The actors created a rogue domain administrator account using Mimikatz.

actions.name: Use rogue domain administrator account to propagate via RDP to multiple hosts
actions.description: Using the newly created rogue domain administrator account, the actors leveraged RDP to propagate to several hosts within the network.

actions.name: Manually disable Windows Defender via GUI on multiple hosts
actions.description: Upon logging into each host, the actors manually disabled Windows Defender via the Graphical User Interface (GUI).

actions.name: Implant Ngrok executables and configuration files on multiple hosts
actions.description: The actors implanted Ngrok executables and configuration files on multiple hosts to maintain persistence and proxy RDP sessions.

actions.name: Execute PowerShell command on Active Directory to obtain list of all domain machines
actions.description: The threat actors executed a PowerShell command on the Active Directory to obtain a list of all machines attached to the domain.

actions.name: Change password for local administrator account on several hosts
actions.description: The threat actors changed the password for the local administrator account on several hosts as a backup in case the rogue domain administrator account was detected and terminated.

actions.name: Attempt to dump LSASS process with task manager
actions.description: The threat actor was observed attempting to dump the Local Security Authority Subsystem Service (LSASS) process with task manager but was stopped by additional anti-virus.

actions.name: Remove malicious file mde.ps1 from disk
actions.description: The actors removed the malicious file mde.ps1 from the disk to evade detection.

actions.name: Malware tests for internet connectivity by pinging 8.8.8.8
actions.description: The RuntimeBroker.exe associated file tests for internet connectivity by pinging 8.8.8.8.
